top_signals.title: NY Attorney General Letitia James warns Clarity Act would ‘dilute’ states’ ability to go after fraud as pressure mounts
top_signals.summary: NYAG Letitia James urged Congress to tighten a crypto bill, warning that it would weaken states' ability to police the industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
